listing.name: Master of Magic / ReMoM
listing.summary: Run Master of Magic with ReMoM using the original game data from your own DOS installation.

steps.title: Choose the engine archive
steps.instruction: Extract the full Windows ZIP and open ReMoM.exe. On Linux, extract the tarball and run ReMoM with SDL2 and SDL2_mixer installed.

steps.title: Point ReMoM at your own Master of Magic files
steps.instruction: ReMoM looks for version 1.31 files in the usual GOG, Steam and CD install locations. If it cannot find them, follow the upstream guide to set game_data in ReMoM.ini, or put the original .LBX files next to the executable. Open the same program again to play.

references.title: Keep the working save folder
references.instruction: The default save folder is %APPDATA%/ReMoM on Windows or ~/.local/share/ReMoM on Linux. The program can copy SAVE1.GAM through SAVE9.GAM from your original on first run. Keep the working copies before replacing the engine with a newer upstream release.

warnings: Portcove does not back up your ReMoM saves.
